description: Molecular Adverse Outcome Pathway for [AOP 121](https://identifiers.org/aop/121), "Urinary bladder calculi leading to urothelial papillomas and carcinomas (in mouse and rat)". Key Event nodes and the relationships between them are from AOP-Wiki RDF 97191db (2026-08-01); the green pathway nodes are the molecular pathways mapped to each Key Event and approved in the molAOP Builder (snapshot 2026-08-13). The source AOP was developed in a non-human species; the mapped molecular pathways are human.
title: Urinary bladder calculi leading to urothelial papillomas and carcinomas
